title: Month 7 Day 4
notes:
This teaching opens with the duty to fear Yahweh and keep His commands, then moves from Deuteronomy 16 into the Day of Atonement—the Fast, Yeshua’s teaching on fasting, and the fast Yahweh desires in Isaiah 58. It walks through Leviticus 16, the two goats, Azazel, the sprinkling of blood, and the high-priestly lineage, then turns to Enoch, where Azazel is blamed for all sin. The study then traces the 78 generations and 5,500-year timeline toward 70 AD and asks whether Yeshua returned after the tribulation, reading Luke 21, Mark 13, Matthew 24, 1–2 Thessalonians, Revelation 19–20, and the wars of Joel, Micah, and Ezekiel 38–39.
